"import csv
import os
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt

# Read data file
csv_path = 'load_03.csv'
rows = []
with open(csv_path, 'r', newline='') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    header = next(reader)
    for row in reader:
        rows.append(row)

# Parse data
data = []
for row in rows:
    case = row[0]
    load_factor = float(row[1])
    cycles = int(row[2])
    data.append((case, load_factor, cycles))

# Compute statistics
n_cases = len(data)
loads = [d[1] for d in data]
cycles_list = [d[2] for d in data]

load_max = max(loads)
load_mean = sum(loads) / len(loads)
total_cycles = sum(cycles_list)

print(f"N cases: {n_cases}")
print(f"load max: {load_max}")
print(f"load mean: {load_mean:.4f}")
print(f"total cycles: {total_cycles}")

# Round display values as specified
display_load_max = round(load_max, 2)  # 2.39
display_load_mean = round(load_mean, 1)  # 1.7
display_total_cycles = total_cycles
display_n_cases = n_cases

# Create presentation
prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = Inches(10)
prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)

# Slide 1: Title slide
slide1 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[0])  # Title slide layout
title1 = slide1.shapes.title
subtitle1 = slide1.placeholders[1]
title1.text = "Engineering Load Test Report"
subtitle1.text = "Data-Anchored Analysis of Load Factors and Cycles"

# Slide 2: Data slide with table
slide2 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])  # Title only layout
title2 = slide2.shapes.title
title2.text = "Data"

# Add table
rows_count = len(data) + 1  # header + data rows
cols_count = 3
table_shape = slide2.shapes.add_table(rows_count, cols_count, Inches(1), Inches(1.5), Inches(8), Inches(5))
table = table_shape.table

# Header
headers = ['case', 'load_factor', 'cycles']
for i, h in enumerate(headers):
    cell = table.cell(0, i)
    cell.text = h

# Data rows
for r, (case, load_factor, cycles) in enumerate(data, start=1):
    table.cell(r, 0).text = case
    table.cell(r, 1).text = str(load_factor)
    table.cell(r, 2).text = str(cycles)

# Slide 3: Summary slide
slide3 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])
title3 = slide3.shapes.title
title3.text = "Summary"

left = Inches(1)
top = Inches(1.5)
width = Inches(8)
height = Inches(4)
txBox = slide3.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
tf = txBox.text_frame

bullet_lines = [
    f"N cases = {display_n_cases}",
    f"load max = {display_load_max}",
    f"load mean = {display_load_mean}",
    f"total cycles = {display_total_cycles}",
]

for i, line in enumerate(bullet_lines):
    p = tf.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = line
    p.level = 0

# Slide 4: Next steps slide
slide4 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])
title4 = slide4.shapes.title
title4.text = "Next steps"

txBox4 = slide4.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(1), Inches(1.5), Inches(8), Inches(4))
tf4 = txBox4.text_frame

next_steps = [
    "Validate load_factor thresholds against design limits.",
    "Review high-cycle cases for fatigue analysis.",
    "Schedule follow-up tests for outliers.",
    "Update the engineering test plan with findings.",
]
for i, line in enumerate(next_steps):
    p = tf4.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else tf4.add_paragraph()
    p.text = line
    p.level = 0

# Save
prs.save('report.pptx')
print("report.pptx created successfully")"
